negative_condition: An MCP result schema that omits required fields (e.g., missing mutation_guard, missing errors array, or missing schema_version) must fail the contract fixture check.

mutated_contract.violation: Incomplete MCP result schema: required top-level fields are absent.

assertion: The P089 smoke gate must reject an MCP result schema fixture that does not declare all required top-level fields: schema_version, status, enabled_state, generated_at, limits_applied, summary, rows, errors, mutation_guard.
